title: Description and Part Number cannot be left empty when editing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Clear the Description completely.
  4. Clear the Part Number completely.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Description is empty.

Step 4:

  • Part Number is empty.

Step 5:

  • "Description is a required field" shows under Description and "Part number is a required field" under Part Number.
  • The part is not saved: the window stays open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.

Step 7:

  • The fields still read part A's description and number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N2: “An empty Description shows "Description is a required field" and an empty Part Number shows "Part number is a required field". The part is not saved.”
  • Key Decisions: “Part Number is required, on create and on edit. The Part Library link, the duplicate check and the other-locations warning all depend on the number. A shop without its paperwork yet types a temporary number and corrects it later, which keeps the part, its history and its Part Library entry (Story 13).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
